name: Special City Council Meeting Agenda - Supplemental Packet Posted
agenda_text:
RAY PEARL  NED E DAVIS  KELLY HONIG  SUSAN McSWEENEY  BRAD HALPERN
  Mayor  Mayor Pro Tem  Councilmember  Councilmember  Councilmember

  AGENDA
  Special Meeting of the City Council
  CITY OF WESTLAKE VILLAGE
  City Council Chambers
  31200 Oak Crest Drive
  Westlake Village, CA 91361

  WEDNESDAY, DECEMBER 6, 2023 - 6:30 p.m.
  .
  PUBLIC PARTICIPATION OPTIONS:
 This meeting will be conducted in a hybrid model. The Public may join this meeting virtually or
 attend in-person in the Council Chambers.

 Written comments may be emailed to the City Clerk's Office at antoinette@wlv.org no later than
 12:00 p.m. on the meeting date. Written comments will be provided to City Council prior to the
 meeting and posted at https://www.wlv.org/569/City-Council-Supplemental-Packets

  Please click the link below to join the webinar:
  https://us02web.zoom.us/j/89394690036
  Webinar ID: 893 9469 0036
  One Tap Mobile:
  +16694449171,,89394690036# OR +16699009128,,89394690036#
  Telephone:
  +1 669 444 9171 OR +1 669 900 9128 OR +1 253 205 0468

 Virtual participants will be muted until recognized at the appropriate time by the Mayor or
 the meeting chairperson. The meeting host will announce when individuals wishing to
 speak must “raise their hand”, at which time they will be unmuted.

 In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, if you require a disability-related
 modification or accommodation to attend or participate in this meeting, including auxiliary aids or
 services, please call the City Clerk’s office at (818) 706-1613 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.

 Any disclosable public records related to an open session item on a regular meeting agenda and
 distributed by the City to the City Council less than 72 hours prior to that meeting are available for
 public inspection at City Hall (31200 Oak Crest Drive, Westlake Village) during normal business
 hours and posted on the City’s Website - https://www.wlv.org/569/City-Council-Supplemental-
 Packets.
 CALL TO ORDER: 6:30 p.m.

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE:

ROLL CALL:  Councilmembers Halpern, McSweeney, Honig, Mayor Pro Tem
  Davis, Mayor Pearl

APPROVAL OF AGENDA:

APPROVAL OF MINUTES:

Minutes of November 8, 2023 Regular City Council Meeting and the November 14, 2023
Closed Session Meeting.

SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS/CEREMONIAL MATTERS: None

PUBLIC COMMENTS: Members of the public may address the City Council on items not on the
printed agenda. Please observe the time limit of three minutes. Members of the public may offer comment
telephonically or otherwise electronically by using Zoom teleconference service options as listed on Page
1 of this agenda. When attending in-person, complete a Speaker Card and submit it to the City Clerk prior
to the meeting starting.

COUNCIL RESPONSE:

STAFF COMMENTS:

COUNCIL COMMENTS:

CITY COUNCIL COMMITTEE REPORTS: Reports on City Council Committee meetings held.

1.  CULTURAL RECREATION COMMITTEE REPORT – COMMUNITY PARK
  SIGNAGE AND TRASH ENCLOSURE, AND SHADE STRUCTURE AT CANYON
  OAKS PARK - Update to the City Council to hear input as staff and the Cultural
  Recreation Committee continue to work on these projects before returning to
  Council for action at future Council meeting.

PUBLIC HEARINGS:

1.  CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT NO. 95-003, MODIFICATION NO. 3;
  RESOLUTION NO. 2328-23 - Adopt Resolution No. 2328-23, determining
  Conditional Use Permit No. 95-003, Modification No. 3 is exempt from CEQA and
  approving CUP 95-003, Modification No. 3 to authorize the continued operation
  and modification of an existing rooftop wireless telecommunications facility located
  at 5706 Corsa Avenue.

  RESOLUTION NO. 2328-23 - A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY
  OF WESTLAKE VILLAGE APPROVING CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT NO. 95-003,
  MODIFICATION NO. 3 RELATIVE TO THE CONTINUED OPERATION AND
  MODIFICATION OF AN EXISTING ROOFTOP WIRELESS TELECOMMUNICATIONS
  FACILITY AT 5706 CORSA AVENUE
 PUBLIC HEARINGS (continued):

2.  CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT NO. 23-005 MODIFICATION NO. 1; RESOLUTION
  NO. 2329-23 - Adopt Resolution No. 2329-23, determining Modification No. 1 of
  Conditional Use Permit No. 23-005 is exempt from CEQA and approving
  Modification No. 1 of Conditional Use Permit No. 23-005 to authorize an expansion
  of alcohol service into Suite 603 in conjunction with the operation of a new
  restaurant located in Suites 601, 602, and 603 of the Lindero Oaks commercial
  center at 31149 Via Colinas.

  RESOLUTION NO. 2329-23 - A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY
  OF WESTLAKE VILLAGE APPROVING MODIFICATION NO. 1 OF CONDITIONAL USE
  PERMIT NO. 23-005 TO AUTHORIZE AN EXPANSION OF ALCOHOL SERVICE INTO
  SUITE 603 IN CONJUNCTION WITH THE OPERATION OF A NEW RESTAURANT
  LOCATED AT 31149 VIA COLINAS, SUITES 601, 602, & 603.

CONSENT CALENDAR: Matters listed under the Consent Calendar are considered to be routine and
will be enacted by one motion and one vote. Unless otherwise requested by a Councilmember, there will
be no separate discussion of these items. If discussion is desired, that item will be removed from the
Consent Calendar and will be considered separately.

  APPROVAL OF WARRANTS: Warrants effective November 15, 2023 in the
  amount of $ 353,538.44 and December 1, 2023 in the amount of $ 502,490.00

  GENERAL BUSINESS:

  1. CONTRACT WITH SESAC LLC FOR MUSIC LICENSING AT SPECIAL
  EVENTS - Approve the contract with SESAC and that the City Manager be
  authorized to execute the contract on behalf of the City.

  2. PROFESSIONAL SERVICES AGREEMENT WITH PECKHAM &
  MCKINNEY, INC. FOR RECRUITMENT OF A DEPUTY CITY MANAGER -
  Approve a Professional Services Agreement with Peckham & McKinney, Inc.
  in the amount of $27,000 to conduct a recruitment for a Deputy City Manager.

OLD BUSINESS: None

NEW BUSINESS: None

ADJOURNMENT:

This agenda was posted on Thursday, November 30, 2023 at 4:45 p.m. on the City’s website and
in the Posting Board at City Hall.
  City Clerk
  Novdmber 30, 2023
